items.name: Sampled data
items.definition: Sampled data：Data obtained for the system variables only at discrete intervals.

items.name: Steady-state tracking error
items.definition: Steady-state tracking error：The error between the output and the reference input after transients have died out.

items.name: 幅相频率特性曲线
items.definition: 以横轴为实轴、纵轴为虚轴构成的复数平面上，以频率ω为参变量绘制的频率特性曲线。

items.name: Determining PM from Bode plot
items.definition: Determining PM from Bode plot：Measure angle of G(jω) as it crosses the magnitude=1 circle.
